name: Mango DMC and spectra Anderson et al. 2020
description:
This data set contains NIR absorbance spectra of the wavelength range 309 - 1149 nm of mango mesocarp with corresponding dry matter content values. This was the data set used in Anderson et al. 2020 "Achieving robustness across season, location and cultivar for a NIRS model for intact mango fruit dry matter content"

Version 3 now contains an additional season of external validation in upcoming publication Walsh et al. 2024 "Evaluation of 1D Convolutional Neural Network in Estimation of Mango Dry Matter Content"

A table has been added for reference sample descriptions (by cultivar with mean and standard deviation).
method: Follow the steps listed in the materials and methods in the companion paper.
